From: Alex Chen <alex.chen@acme-analytics.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Interested in Redwood via AWS Marketplace - quick intro?

Hi Jordan,

We discovered Redwood on the AWS Marketplace and are evaluating inference solutions for embeddings and chat features in our analytics product. I'm leading the evaluation at Acme Analytics. A few quick questions before we book a demo:

- Do you offer a private deployment (VPC/on-prem) option for regulated datasets?
- Typical latency and cost profile for embedding-only workloads?
- Any relevant compliance docs (SOC2, data residency)?

Would love a 30-minute intro/demo this week if you have availability.

Thanks,
Alex Chen
Senior Product Manager
Acme Analytics
alex.chen@acme-analytics.com
(415) 555-0182

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 09:38:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Interested in Redwood via AWS Marketplace - quick intro?

Hi Alex - great to meet you and thanks for reaching out (and welcome from the Marketplace!).

Quick answers: yes, we support Private deployments (VPC & on-prem) - I'll loop in Marissa (AE) and Camila (SE) for any deeper compliance or architecture questions. For a first pass, a 30-minute intro to walk through use case + short demo works well.

I have open slots:
- Wed 8/19 10:00-10:30 AM PT
- Wed 8/19 3:00-3:30 PM PT
- Thu 8/20 9:00-9:30 AM PT

If none of those work here's my Calendly: https://calendly.com/jordan-redwood/30min

Agenda suggestion (flexible):
1) Quick intros + goals (5 min)
2) How Redwood approaches embeddings & low-latency inference (10 min)
3) Demo of embedding search + routing/quantization controls (10 min)
4) Next steps / procurement questions (5 min)

Marissa - looping you in to join for pricing/commit questions. Camila - if you have a minute to confirm availability to join the demo, appreciate it.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Sales Development Representative | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com
